Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Class MailAccountStore

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailAccountStore
public class MailAccountStore extends Object
Persists the configured MailAccounts under the /mail/accounts Preferences node - one child node per account - and owns the sealed password of any account in MailAccount.CredentialMode.SAVED mode (via CredentialVault).

Accounts are kept in a stable, user-visible order (a persisted index) so the picker and folder tree do not reshuffle between launches. Exactly one account may be flagged default; save(MailAccount) enforces that invariant.

    • save

      public void save(MailAccount account)
      Writes (or rewrites) one account and flushes. If this account is flagged default, every other account's default flag is cleared so exactly one wins; if it is the first account, it becomes the default automatically.
